author: Kristen Lawrence
text: We used Arnett for pumping out our septic tank and cleaning our filters. We were pleased with their kindness, communication, punctuality, and overall professionalism in every way. Their prices are great!! The crew definitely earned a 5 star review. We will continue using them in the future for all of our septic needs. Thanks for a great experience.

author: Chad Sorrells
text: Excellent company!  Everyone I dealt with was professional and courteous. They did a great job and I will use them on future septic needs.

author: Halle Kiley
text: These guys are great! We thought it was time for the septic tank to be pumped out, so we called Arnett. They were out at our house within 3 hours, found the issue, and fixed our issue! Highly recommend!

author: Sebastian D.
text: Luke and his partner did a fantastic job! I had called initially because I thought my drain field had failed, but instead all they recommended was a pump and potentially a new septic lid after inspecting the components and verifying everything was in good shape. They even checked some of the septic pipes in my crawl space to make sure nothing was leaking, along with covering the hole I dug when I noticed the leak prior! Price was very competitive and they did a phenomenal job. Will be using this company going forward!

author: keisha schweitzer
text: If I could give these guys more stars I would ! Very professional and the nicest guys. Thanks for making this processes very stress free.
